_strategyNote: Per GPT review: the full BotConfiguration body is too complex and tenant-dependent for exact-parity. Contract uses schema-based coverage of discriminators + minimal required fields, not whole-payload equality.

kindDiscriminators._note: Root discriminator. Server rejects without it.

requiredFields.constraint: non-empty string — this IS the agent name MCS shows
string (empty allowed; populated later via LSP/Gateway)

lastVerifiedBy: HAR capture from MCS UI bot creation (bot dde31320-3039-f111-88b4-7c1e528d32a4 in dktest)
knownQuirks: Missing the settings.default-2.1.0.content block causes MCS to NEVER materialize the GptComponent — agent exists but has no orchestrator. Discovered via HAR diff 2026-04-15.
After creation, MUST call POST /powervirtualagents/bots/{id}/api/botcomponents with {"Kind":["BotEntity"]} to trigger component materialization. Otherwise UI shows empty agent.
No PvaProvision call needed — rich configuration + PVA BotEntity call replaces the legacy provision step.
iconbase64 field accepts PNG base64; large icons (>50KB) may cause request failures on some gateway regions.

errorCases.reason: User lacks Power Platform maker role on target env
Server rejects incomplete settings.default-2.1.0.content — agent creates but without GptComponent
